DIVERGENCE: invalid JSON. Both legs answer status invalid with an error, but the TEXT is the parser's own: V8 says "Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1 (line 1 column 2)", serde_json says "EOF while parsing an object at line 1 column 1". Matching it would mean reimplementing V8's JSON diagnostics, so the message is recorded as a known reimplementation difference rather than approximated. Everything else about the case (exists, status, empty servers, contents never echoed) is asserted by the neighbouring cases.
cases.allowDivergence: V8 vs serde_json JSON parse-error text. Rust cannot reproduce a V8 diagnostic string; the surrounding fields agree.
